description:
Parent: fz-bfh. RESOLVED -- no repro survives at main 417c5b0b5.

## What this reported

`Enum.reduce/2` over a Range and `Enum.reduce_while/3` over a Map both hit a
`settled_callable_boundary` multi-surface error.

## What is true now

Both surfaces work, individually and together in one program, on interp and run:

    range = 1..7//2
    map   = %{2 => :two, 1 => :one}
    Enum.reduce(range, fn (x, acc) -> x * acc end)                    => 105
    Enum.reduce_while(map, [], fn ({k,v}, acc) -> {:cont, [{k,v}|acc]} end)
                                                     => [{2, :two}, {1, :one}]
    Enum.reduce(range, 0, fn (x, acc) -> acc + x end)                 => 16
    Enum.reduce_while(range, 0, fn (x, acc) -> {:cont, acc + x} end)  => 16

No `settled_callable_boundary` error on any of them. The combined program was
tried specifically because the ticket names a MULTI-SURFACE error -- one surface
passing proves less than several passing together -- and it is clean too.

Closed on the absence of a repro, not on a fix commit: the mechanism was retired
somewhere in the fz-6gb / fz-f98.14.11 / fz-f98.16..19 arc without being
attributed here. If the multi-surface error reappears, file fresh with the new
repro rather than reopening this -- the surfaces named above are no longer the
way in.

Found while re-triaging the deferred `enum_tier0` fixture, which cited this
ticket among four blockers; two of the other three (fz-bfh.1, fz-bfh.4) were
already closed, and the live one is fz-bfh.3.
